nvitk.restoration.bilateral¶

Backend-aware bilateral filtering.

Public API¶

  • bilateral() ─ high-level 2-D / 3-D dispatcher

  • bilateral_2d() ─ force a 2-D filter (with optional stack mode)

  • bilateral_3d() ─ force a true 3-D filter

  • estimate_bilateral_parameters() ─ auto-selection helper for sigmas

Backend selection¶

The concrete implementation is chosen from nvitk.core.backend.get_current_backend():

  • numpy → skimage.restoration.denoise_bilateral() (CPU, slice-by-slice for 3-D).

  • cupy → custom CUDA raw kernels from _cuda_kernels (GPU, native 2-D/3-D).

Inputs can be raw numpy/cupy arrays or nvitk.types.Image. The returned type mirrors the input (Image → Image, array → array).

Module Contents¶

nvitk.restoration.bilateral.estimate_bilateral_parameters(image: Any, *, spatial_pct: float = 0.02, spatial_min: float = 1.0, spatial_max: float = 5.0) → Tuple[float, float]¶

Return (sigma_spatial, sigma_color) for image.

sigma_spatial is a fraction of the shortest spatial dimension (clamped to [spatial_min, spatial_max]). sigma_color defaults to numpy.std() (legacy scikit-image convention).

Accepts Image, NumPy or CuPy arrays.

nvitk.restoration.bilateral.bilateral(image: nvitk.types.Image | Any, *, sigma_spatial: float | None = None, sigma_color: float | None = None, kernel_radius: int | None = None, do_3d: bool = False, axis: int = 0, backend: Literal['auto', 'numpy', 'cupy'] = 'auto') → nvitk.types.Image | Any¶

Edge-preserving bilateral filter.

Parameters:

  • image – 2-D or 3-D input (Image or raw array).

  • sigma_spatial – Bilateral parameters; auto-estimated from image when omitted (see estimate_bilateral_parameters()).

  • sigma_color – Bilateral parameters; auto-estimated from image when omitted (see estimate_bilateral_parameters()).

  • kernel_radius – Half-width of the spatial kernel. Defaults to ceil(2 * sigma_spatial).

  • do_3d – If True and the input is 3-D, run a native 3-D filter. If False, apply a 2-D filter slice-by-slice along axis (scikit-image semantics).

  • axis – Slicing axis for stack-by-stack 3-D filtering (ignored when do_3d).

  • backend – Force "numpy" (skimage) or "cupy" (CUDA kernels); "auto" (default) follows get_current_backend().

Returns:

Same wrapping as image and same backend as the input (when backend='auto') or the requested backend otherwise.

Return type:

Image | ndarray
